title: German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat
summary: Bitcoin Magazine German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat The Bundestag approved a bill that would let German customs freeze crypto and other assets over €100,000 of unclear origin without a criminal case. Permanent confiscation would still require a court, and the timing of the Bundesrat vote remains unclear. This post German Bundestag Lets Customs Freeze Crypto Over €100,000 Without a Criminal Case as the Bill Goes to the Bundesrat first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
